primary_claim: Small and even tiny open-weight LLMs (introspective ability emerging around 1B parameters and improving with scale) can localize where a steering-vector-injected 'thought' occurs among several sentences at above-chance accuracy, demonstrating introspection via a new single-forward-pass localization protocol

effect.value: gemma3-27b-it reaches 98% accuracy when injected at layer 18 of 62 (18th layer, out of 62)

depends_on: Jack Lindsey, Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
vgel, Small Models Can Introspect, Too
contradicts_or_qualifies: Anthropic's original introspection experiment, where the strongest introspection effect was shown at later layers, versus this protocol finding localization strongest at early layers (e.g. 18th of 62)
stated_future_work: Understand how and why this capability is learned during training
Study the introspection mechanism using a two-sentence version of the protocol with activation patching applied to the logit difference
quote: We find that small LLMs, even tiny ones, do have introspective ability: they can localize the injected thought above chance level with high statistical significance.
